messages:
tara-docs: I opened a small PR to add a compact Autoscale quick-reference into the Dedicated provisioning docs (https://git.redwood/docs/pull/527). Before merging I need three tiny items: a 2-3 line k8s pod annotation example for ReservedPool binding, a minimal inline Terraform autoscale resource, a one-line Python SDK call, and a single-sentence SLA exclusion. Can @sam-eng and @oliver-infra help?
sam-eng: I can do the TF and Python. Will keep TF to the minimal fields so people can copy-paste.
oliver-infra: k8s micro-snippet and an OSS note: we annotate pods for tenant binding and set a priorityClass. Example:```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  annotations:
    redwood/tenant-id: "tenant-123"
    redwood/reserved: "true"
spec:
  priorityClassName: redwood-dedicated  # OSS: create or use high-priority
  containers:
  - name: worker
    image: redwood/llm-runtime:stable
```
maria-ml: perf caveat: autoscaling new replicas may add ~200-600ms KV-cache warmup based on model. Recommend min_replicas>0 for tight p99s. I'll add a short note in PR comments about which model variants persist KV-cache.

sam-eng: TF (minimal inline):```hcl
resource "redwood_dedicated_autoscale_policy" "a" {
  tenant_id    = "tenant-123"
  min_replicas = 1
  max_replicas = 5
  cpu_target   = 65
  burst_policy { enabled = true, burst_capacity = 1 }
}
```
Python (one-liner):```py
policy = DedicatedClient().create_autoscale_policy(tenant_id="tenant-123", min_replicas=1, max_replicas=5, cpu_target=65, burst_capacity=1)
```
jenna-techwriter: Draft SLA exclusion sentence: "Evictions due to cloud provider preemption, platform maintenance, operator-initiated drains, or tenant misconfiguration (e.g., missing reserved annotation) are excluded from uptime credits." OK to insert?

chris-sre: yes, and add a concrete example line: "Exempt: spot instance reclamation during provider maintenance." SRE reviewed and fine with wording.

docs-bot: linkcheck: 1 broken link found (/docs/legacy/dedicated-module).

tara-docs: I removed the legacy reference in the branch and asked for a rerun. Will merge when linkcheck is green and the tiny snippets are in. Thanks all! :rocket:
